cases.name: test-implement-cd-normal
cases.description: Verifies that supplying a valid target path updates the working directory successfully.
cases.expected_behavior: The directory updates correctly without spawning external tools.

cases.name: test-implement-cd-edge
cases.description: Verifies behavior when supplying an invalid or nonexistent target path.
cases.expected_behavior: The directory remains unchanged and an error indicator is reported.

cases.name: test-implement-cd-oracle
cases.description: Dynamic verification of directory navigation across multiple sequential steps.
cases.expected_behavior: Sequential path changes update state accurately.
